FN-ZNTXKRW-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 153
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/26/2024
Senate Bill 153 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general
funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited and increase receipts to the various
funds that administrative fees for expungement are deposited into, by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the number of individuals adjudicated as a youthful offender that would now
qualify for expungement based on the provisions of this bill.
Page 1
